children: New Zealand automation and robotics firm's FY26 revenue rose 7% to record high
Operating EBITDA for FY26 grew 14% year-over-year
Growth driven by Mining and Materials Handling & Logistics segments
Scott expects FY27 revenue of NZ$310-340 mln
Company sees FY27 operating EBITDA of NZ$36-41 mln
Destination 2030 targets NZ$530 mln in group revenue by FY30
MINING EQUIPMENT DEMAND – Mining revenue rose 22% to NZ$62.3 mln, driven by Rocklabs standard-equipment sales and continued mining investment
LIFECYCLE SERVICES – An expanding installed base and lifecycle-services focus lifted recurring revenue 9% to NZ$95 mln, or 32.3% of Group revenue
MARGIN EXPANSION – Net margin rose to 30% on higher-margin Mining and service mix, improved project execution, modular solutions and cost control
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
